0.0.11.en: ## What's New 🎉 **All Platforms** - Added an enable/disable toggle for installed keyboards. Disabled keyboards stay in the list but are hidden from hotkeys, the IME switcher, auto-activation, and tray/property menus. - Keyboard cards now show secondary actions (View Layout, Disable, Remove) as compact 38×38 icon buttons with tooltips; Remove has a red danger hover. - Keyboard layout viewer redesigned: - Pin and PDF buttons moved into the title bar as SVG icons under a unified ghost-button style. - New per-key label layout: ASCII top-left, shifted top-right, unshifted bottom-center. - Platform-aware modifier labels: CMD/OPT on macOS, SUPER on Linux, WIN/ALT on Windows. - New visual style — white window, light-gray chassis, softly-shadowed keys. - External links (Website, GitHub) from the About page now open in the system browser. Previously broken on macOS where WKWebView silently ignored target="_blank" clicks. **Linux** - IBus layout/property menu now refreshes immediately when keyboards are enabled/disabled or installed/removed via the GUI — no need to deactivate and reactivate KeyMagic. - Instructional code blocks (e.g. the IBus symbol customization commands) gained a one-click copy button. ## Downloads **Windows** **macOS** **Linux** - **Debian (amd64)**: `keymagic3_0.0.11_amd64.deb` - **Debian (arm64)**: `keymagic3_0.0.11_arm64.deb` - **RPM (x86_64)**: `keymagic3-0.0.11-1.x86_64.rpm` - **RPM (aarch64)**: `keymagic3-0.0.11-1.aarch64.rpm` ## Installation Instructions #### Windows 1. Download and run the installer 2. Follow the installation wizard 3. KeyMagic will be available in your system tray #### macOS 1. Download and open the DMG file 2. Drag KeyMagic to your Applications folder 3. Launch KeyMagic from Applications 4. Add KeyMagic in System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources #### Linux **Quick Install (Recommended):** ```bash curl -fsSL https://thantthet.github.io/keymagic-3/install.sh | bash ``` This will automatically: - Detect your Linux distribution - Add the KeyMagic repository - Install the latest version - Keep KeyMagic updated through your package manager **Manual Installation:** *Debian/Ubuntu:* ```bash sudo dpkg -i keymagic3_0.0.11_*.deb sudo apt-get install -f # Install any missing dependencies ``` *Fedora/RHEL:* ```bash sudo rpm -i keymagic3-0.0.11-1.*.rpm ``` **Post-Installation:** 1. Restart IBus: `ibus restart` 2. Or log out and log back in 3. Add KeyMagic in your system's input method settings
